lesson: The system is consistently failing by attempting to front-run reversals against the dominant 4h/Daily trend, resulting in 8 consecutive stop-outs. The reliance on low-timeframe liquidity sweeps (SMC) is proving ineffective because the broader market structure is overriding these minor signals.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend-Filter Rule' that mandates all trades must align with the 4h timeframe direction, strictly prohibiting counter-trend entries regardless of local liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps LESS when they contradict the 4h market structure.
